subject: Post-call: Context footprint & $/1M token targets for HealthMap pilot
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ramos <carlos@healthmap.ai>
Cc: Elena Zhou <elena@healthmap.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Context footprint & $/1M token targets for HealthMap pilot

Thanks again for the call this morning — quick recap and a few asks so we can size a pilot/pricing proposal that matches your expected mix.

Key usage profile (as discussed)
- Avg prompt tokens: ~420 tokens (median ~350)
- Avg completion tokens: ~1,100 tokens (75th percentile ~1,600)
- Token mix by window: 8k window used ~60% of generation calls; 32k eligible ~30%; 128k used for large analytic exports/batch jobs ~10%
- Expected user flow: short prompts for realtime chat + longer background/analysis completions for weekly batch exports

Initial cost/volume points we discussed
- Your current rough estimate: ~100M tokens/month today with expected ramp to ~120M/month in 3 months (please confirm)
- Budget target: you mentioned wanting < $1,000 per 1M tokens; would $800–$900/1M be comfortable for a pilot? (we can show how caching/batching reduces effective $/1M)

Pilot proposal (3-week technical + 4-week pricing evaluation)
- Deliverables: sample prompt set evaluation, live pilot on hosted API dev pool (option to switch to a small dedicated dev pool), token-level cost breakdown and mocked $/1M economics based on your sample prompts
- Success criteria: matching latency SLOs for 95th pct, cost per 1M tokens within agreed target range, no major quality regressions on 50 eval prompts

Next asks from your side
1) Confirm the monthly token ramp (current and target after 3 months) — you can reply inline.
2) Share a small sample of 100 representative prompts + expected completion lengths (we can accept anonymized rows).
3) Tell us whether procurement needs a PO by early July (we can align pilot timing).

Attachment: healthmap_pricing_template.xlsx (simple template for you to fill with sample prompt counts and expected frequency)

Thanks — I’ll loop Karthik and Marissa for cost modeling once you confirm the sample.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Ramos <carlos@healthmap.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Zhou <elena@healthmap.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context footprint & $/1M token targets for HealthMap pilot

Thanks, Evelyn — great recap. Confirming a few items and adding clarifications.

- Monthly ramp: current pilot (internal) ~35M tokens; expected production ramp to ~120M tokens/month within 8–10 weeks after launch (so 120M is accurate as a near-term forecast).
- Prompt/completion profile: your averages line up with our sampled telemetry — average prompt ~400–450, average completion closer to 1,000–1,200. We see heavier tails on completions during weekly analysis runs.
- Window mix: I previously thought 32k would be lower (we see ~20%) but after digging with the team I agree 30% 32k eligible sounds right; 128k will be small but crucial for exports.

Budget: we’re targeting ~ $700–$900 per 1M tokens for the pilot phase. Our procurement team will look for a 6–8 week trial that can convert to a PO if pilot metrics match.

Procurement timeline: PO decision likely in July; procurement requires SOW + one-page pricing summary.

I’ll upload a small anonymized prompt sample (100 rows) to the Drive link you shared today — expect by EOD Friday.

Regards,
Carlos Ramos
Head of Product, HealthMap AI
carlos@healthmap.ai
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ramos <carlos@healthmap.ai>
Cc: Elena Zhou <elena@healthmap.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context footprint & $/1M token targets for HealthMap pilot

Appreciate the fast turn. Thanks for confirming the 120M target and the $700–$900/1M range — that gives us a solid anchor.

Next steps from our side:
- Karthik will follow up with a short cost breakdown showing hosted vs dedicated estimates at your mixed-window profile.
- Please upload the 100-row sample to the Drive folder (link in metadata) and mark which rows correspond to realtime chat vs batch exports. That lets us run a small eval and produce the token-level breakdown by call type.
- We’ll prepare a one-page pricing summary + SOW draft you can drop into procurement.

Security/ops: if your team needs a security questionnaire answered before the pilot, please send the doc and we’ll route to our Security team; we’ll also share an AWS VPC checklist if you prefer an isolated private deployment.

Suggested timing: technical walkthrough + pilot kick-off week of June 7 (3-week dev pilot). Are you available the week of June 7 for a 45-min setup session?

I’ve attached the pricing template again for convenience.

Best,
Evelyn

Subject: Quick cost sketch for HealthMap mix (1M token basis)

Carlos — looping in a very brief sketch so you have numbers to show procurement tomorrow. Full model coming after we ingest the 100-row sample.

Attachment: cost_breakdown_1M.pdf (one-page view)

Baseline hosted API (no caching, average mix): ~ $1,100 per 1M tokens
With caching + batching and your projected mix (60% 8k, 30% 32k, 10% 128k): effective cost estimate ~ $750–$850 per 1M tokens (this accounts for prefix caching on repeated prompts and continuous batching on burst windows)
Dedicated dev pool (small reserved commit): ~$450–$600 per 1M tokens (requires 3–6 month commit; ideal for predictable throughput and lower unit cost)

Recommendation: run the 3-week pilot on hosted dev pool + enable KV/prefix caching and our continuous-batching config; if performance and economics meet your target (~$700–$900/1M) we can scope a small dedicated pilot and provide a pricing ladder for 6-month commit.

Scheduling: here’s a Calendly for the June 7 setup slot — https://calendly.com/redwood/healthmap-setup

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
